help:
VidShrink {0}: shrink a video to a size or a quality, without the window.

Usage:
  vidshrink kucult <input> --hedef 25MB | --kalite N [options]
  vidshrink plan <input> --hedef 25MB | --kalite N [options]

Commands:
  kucult (shrink)   Encode the input. Progress goes to stderr, the result to stdout.
  plan              Print the plan and the ffmpeg arguments. Nothing is encoded.

Options:
  --hedef, --target SIZE    Target size: 25MB, 25, 1.5GB.
  --kalite, --quality N     Target quality score, 1-100. The size is derived from it.
  --kodek, --codec C        auto | h264 | hevc | av1. Default auto.
  --cikti, --output PATH    Output file. Default <input>_shrunk.mp4 beside the input.
  --json                    Write the result as JSON on stdout.
  --olcumsuz, --no-measure  Skip the probe encodes; plan from the source bitrate.
  --vmaf                    Measure VMAF on the finished file when ffmpeg has libvmaf.
  --hizli, --fast           Prefer the fast hardware path, like the window's GPU box.

Exit codes:
  0   Done, size inside the band (or the source was already small enough).
  2   Done, but under the band: quality was saturated, the smaller file was kept.
  3   The target could not be met: the size ceiling was exceeded.
  1   Error: ffmpeg missing, unreadable input, encode failure.
  64  Wrong usage.  130  Cancelled with Ctrl+C.
error.bad-quality: Quality must be a number from 1 to 100: {0}
error.bad-codec: Unknown codec: {0}. Use auto, h264, hevc or av1.
error.extra-input: Only one input file is accepted: {0}
error.tool-missing: {0} was not found. Put it on PATH or beside VidShrink.
error.same-output: The output path is the input file.
error.no-space: Not enough disk space: about {0} MB is needed.
result.under-band: Under the band: quality was saturated and the smaller file was kept.
result.ceiling: The size ceiling was exceeded after {0} attempts; nothing was delivered.
result.ceiling-kept: The size ceiling was exceeded after {0} attempts; the smallest result ({1} MB) was delivered anyway.
